name: dup-path-ab
about: Measures what the game does when two enabled mods ship the same file path: gamelab-dup-a and -b both ship scripts/HWPDup/Shared.as (a different WHO), scripts/HWPDup/Same.as (identical) and res/language/english/hwp_dup.lang (different text); each mod's own module logs which it sees. Order a, b.
